name: Sei Kishi Athena -Mesubuta e to Ochiru Ikusa Megami-
original_name: 性騎士アテナ -メス豚へと堕ちる戦女神-
source:
* An unsoiled white knightess plunges into debauchery * 

The empires of Poron and Teros in the great land of Proteonas were at war. 

Locked in a stalemate with no victory in sight, Teros enacted a secret plan. 
It dispatched a covert team to kidnap the enemy's highest ranking knight. 
This was Athena, whom Teros intended to train as their spy 
and carry out their orders. But she was unwaveringly loyal to Poron, and breaking 
her spirit was an undertaking unto itself. She was tortured. Imprisoned. 
At last Teros abandoned its plan, and Athena was executed. 

Just then, Leohart, the dungeonmaster of Teros, entered the scene. 
"To bring her down, and the morale of Poron's army, you need to 
crush her spirit not as a knight, but a woman..." 

And so she was spared the sweet mercy of death, for something worse. 
Leohart would show Poron that Teros could turn its most noble 
into a quivering harlot, shaming her flag and her insignia with 
the juices of fornication. 

When Athena broke at last, she came so hard and so fully 
that she was thankful for every hot r*ping thrust.
